name: Heaven -Death Game-
source:
The southern island of Eden. It was an island worthy of being called the last paradise on earth. 20 visitors have been invited to the island to see the beautiful nature on the island. They were invited as planning "monitors" of a major travel agency. "There is a groundbreaking plan that breaks down the existing tour. Enjoy the unprecedented survival game."

They though it was an epoch-making plan...an invitation to "attraction". But in fact it was just a lie...an invitation to the Death Game. The game starts the moment they land on the island without knowing anything about it. The only rule is to survive. To do that, you must keep killing. The only one who can leave this island is the last one...

The sterling silver sandy beach is stained with blood and the darkness resonates... Why were they chosen as "monitors?" What about the shadow company that invited them? And what is the true purpose of this game? Only the winner of the game...the survivor...can reach the truth...

[Translated and edited from [url=http://www.mink.co.jp/product/red/heaven/plo.html]M na Red's Product Page[/url]]
translation:
南方的伊甸岛，是一座堪称地球最后乐园的岛屿。20名游客受邀来到岛上，欣赏美丽的自然风光。他们以某大型旅行社企划“体验员”的身份受邀。“这里有一项打破传统旅游模式的开创性计划。请尽情享受前所未有的生存游戏。”

他们以为这是一项划时代企划…一次参加“游乐项目”的邀请。但实际上，这只是一场骗局…一张通往死亡游戏的邀请函。众人对真相一无所知，踏上岛屿的瞬间，游戏便已经开始。唯一规则是活下去。为此，你必须不断杀戮。只有最后幸存的一人，才能离开这座岛…

银白色沙滩被鲜血染红，黑暗中回荡着声响…他们为何会被选为“体验员”？邀请他们的影子公司究竟是什么？这场游戏真正的目的又是什么？只有游戏的胜者…最后的生还者…才能抵达真相…

[翻译并编辑自[url=http://www.mink.co.jp/product/red/heaven/plo.html]M na Red产品页面[/url]]
